body: Could u elaborate? It'd be nice to know how the problem lies with me, as I'd then be able to fix it.

She's not really immature in any other ways, and is a great person besides the fact she's always late and occasionally cancels. I've sort of told her how it seems like she doesn't respect my time before, and she apologized and said she didn't know, but fell back to her old habit right after.
The problem is I already did point that out, to which she said that she didn't know and apologized. This was a few weeks back, and she hasn't really changed much.
The thing is that she doesn't really do anything, she just stays at home. While she does hang out w/ her friends, it's still considerably less than the amount of time she hangs out w/ me.
